dt: CTC white papers by Nov 30, 2026 (applications Feb 15, 2027). UMOS white papers by Dec 31, 2026 (applications Feb 1, 2027). mQIS and CPIMS have no target date.
e: Grants for ultrafast optical and x-ray science, molecular quantum information science, electronic-structure theory and interfacial chemistry, including light-matter coupling and topological-material surfaces. U.S. universities may apply under DE-FOA-0003665.
n: DOE BES Chemical Sciences core programs (Ultrafast Molecular & Optical Sciences, Molecular QIS, Computational & Theoretical Chemistry, Condensed Phase & Interfacial Molecular Science) – FY2027 Open Call
